name: jig-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the Jig template engine: lexer, parser, engine, VS Code extension and docs.

scripts.test: bun run build:libs && bun run generate && bun run --filter './packages/*' test
scripts.quick:test: bun run build:libs && bun run generate && bun run --filter './packages/*' quick:test
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:libs && bun run --filter "./packages/*" typecheck
scripts.test:parser: bun run --cwd packages/lexer build && bun run --cwd packages/parser quick:test
scripts.test:jig: bun run build:libs && bun run --cwd packages/jig quick:test
scripts.test:vscode: bun run generate && bun run --cwd packages/vscode quick:test
scripts.build:libs: bun run --cwd packages/lexer build && bun run --cwd packages/parser build
